title: Feature Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: Something a product does that its users value, in the product's own terms and small enough that one story can deliver it. The hinge between a use case and the services that fulfil it: it fulfils use cases and is implemented by services in bounded contexts. Usually a row of the product's feature register; a feature may also have a page of its own.

what.description: What the feature does, in the product's terms.

part_of.description: The product that has the feature. The inverse of features on the product.

fulfils.description: The use cases the feature fulfils. The inverse of fulfilled_by_features on the use case.

implemented_by.description: The services that implement the feature, by slug, in one or more bounded contexts.
